    b=v.to_bytes(4,'little')
    i=data.find(b)
    print(name,hex(v),b.hex(),"offset",i)
# also big-endian
for name,v in [("v1",1784774249),("v2",1718378344)]:
    b=v.to_bytes(4,'big')
    print(name,"BE",data.find(b))
EOF
